 Order

This first application has been filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail in connection with Crime No.453/2024 registered at Police Station - Alot, District Ratlam,(M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 of IPC.
Applicant is in judicial custody since 12.03.2025.
As per the case of prosecution, Shyam Singh was working as Branch Manager of Spandana Sphoorty Financial Limited.

During audit of Spandana Sphoorty Financial Limited, Branch-Alote, District Ratlam(M.P.), it was revealed that the loan officer Khushal Singh, the loan officer Govind Mewada(applicant) and Branch Manager Shyam Singh had interpolated in the loan account of various customers of the company.
They sanctioned and foreclosed the loan account by using forged Adhar Card and Voter Id and manipulated the accounts.
It was revealed that applicant Shyam Singh had NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:12223 2 MCRC-19184-2025 misappropriated Rs.1,50,468/-.
Other accused Khushal Singh has misappropriated Rs.36,60,742/- and applicant Govind Mewada has misappropriated Rs.1,78,151/- by making false entry in the account books.
Accordingly, PS Alote registered FIR for offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 of IPC against Shyam Singh, Khushal Singh and Govind Mewada(applicant).
Applicant Govind Mewada was apprehended on 12.03.2025.
He is in custody ever since.
Shyam Singh and Khushal Singh were also arrested.
Relevant seizures have been made.
Investigation is underway.

sentences.text: Learned Counsel for the applicant, in addition to the grounds mentioned in the application, submits that applicant has been falsely implicated in the matter for the reason that he was loan officer of Spandana Sphoorty Financial Limited, Branch Alote.
No offence, as alleged, is committed by the applicant.
Applicant, to show his bonafide, proposed to deposit the money with the Company under protest, but they refused the deposit of money as FIR had already been lodged.
Applicant is still ready to deposit the money.
Further custodial interrogation of the applicant is not needed in the matter.
Further investigation and trial would take time to conclude.
The prosecution is based on documentary evidence and the statement of accounts.
In similarly situated, co-accused Shyam Singh has been extended benefit of bail vide order dated 16.04.2025, passed in M.Cr.C. No.16018 of 2025.
There is no likelihood of tampering with the evidence.
Therefore, applicant may be extended the benefit of bail.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:12223 3 MCRC-19184-2025
Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent/State opposes the bail application on the ground of gravity of alleged offence.
However, he fairly states that no criminal antecedent is reported against the applicant.
Heard the arguments, perused the grounds for grant of bail stated in the application and the case diary.
Allegedly, the applicant, working as loan officer of Spandana Sphoorty Financial Limited, had misappropriated the amount of investors and customers of the Company by manipulating the accounts.
The veracity of prosecution will be determined after evidence during the trial.
As informed, the applicant is aged around 25 years and was in a private job.
He has a family to look after.
Considering these aspects, there appears to be no possibility of fleeing from justice.
The prosecution is based on documentary evidence.

In absence of criminal antecedents, considering the socio- economic status of the applicant and the complainant, there appears to be no likelihood of tampering with the evidence or influencing the witnesses by the applicant.
The trial would take time to conclude.
There appears to be no compelling reason to continue incarceration of the applicant.
However, the observations, herein-above, are recorded for present application only.

Considering the rival contentions and overall circumstances of the case, in the light of aforesaid facts, but without commenting on the merits, this Court is inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Thus, present application is allowed.
